title: American soldier's off-record sighting
summary: Italo Venturelli tells of American soldier's off-record sighting, about unknown at unknown, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: An American soldier. I saw him on the top of my house. But if I say anything, I'd lose my pension in the US.

plain: A surgeon named Italo Venturelli, interviewed by podcast host Jesse Michels, passes on what an American soldier told him privately. As Venturelli tells it, the soldier said he had seen something over his house but would not speak about it openly, because he feared losing his US military pension. It is told as an example of witnesses staying quiet out of fear.
